How many days have you had this
taken how many times a day?

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Good morning, Mrs. Chen. Tell me what has been going on.
rows.said: 早上好，陈太太。告诉我发生了什么事。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 咳嗽发烧已经五天了。
rows.said: I've had a cough and fever for five days now.

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: How many days have you had this cough and fever?
rows.said: 你咳嗽几天了，还发烧？

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 昨天量体温有3 8度5,
rows.said: Yesterday my temperature was 38.5 degrees,

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Take one tablet twice a day for five days.
rows.said: 每天服用一片，一天两次，连服五天。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 这个药一天要吃几次?
rows.said: This medicine needs to be taken how many times a day?

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Do not skip any doses. Even if you start feeling better.
rows.said: 不要漏服。即使你感觉好转了。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 我怕这药吃了会犯困,
rows.said: I'm afraid if I take this medicine, I'll get drowsy,

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Come back in one week if the fever continues.
rows.said: 如果一周后还在发烧，就回来复诊。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 谢谢医生,麻烦您了。
rows.said: Thank you, doctor, sorry to bother you.
